name: markdown-meta-links
description: Resolve @@key@@ references in VS Code Markdown Preview from a same-directory __meta__.toml file.

commands.title: Markdown Meta Links: Export Resolved Markdown

markdownMetaLinks.metaFileName.description: Meta file name to read beside each Markdown file.

markdownMetaLinks.searchParentDirectorie.description: Search parent directories for the meta file when it is not found beside the Markdown file. By default only the same directory is used.

markdownMetaLinks.unresolvedBehavior.description: How unresolved @@key@@ references are displayed. keep: keep the original marker. plain: display only the key text.
